name: guarded_react
description: ReAct loop with a guardian agent that reviews tool calls before execution. 用户输入 → worker推理 → guardian审查工具调用 → 执行 → 循环。

worker.description: The main agent that interacts with the user and proposes tool calls

guardian.description: The agent that reviews tool calls. Uses process_tool_calls() to filter.

guardian_review.description: guardian 审查工具调用时使用的 prompt 模板。{tool_calls} 会被替换为实际的工具调用列表。
